paper.title: DEEP BATCH ACTIVE LEARNING BY DIVERSE, UNCERTAIN GRADIENT LOWER BOUNDS
paper.authors: Jordan T. Ash, Chicheng Zhang, Akshay Krishnamurthy, John Langford, Alekh Agarwal

core_method.name: BADGE
core_method.summary: Selects informative and diverse batches using hallucinated last-layer gradient embeddings and k-MEANS++ seeding.

paper_claims.method_description: BADGE computes predicted-label final-layer gradient embeddings for unlabeled examples and uses sequential k-MEANS++ seeding to select a diverse batch.
paper_claims.claimed_results: The paper reports strong performance across image and OpenML datasets and multiple architectures and batch sizes.
paper_claims.benchmark_scale: M=100 initial labels; batch sizes B in {100, 1000, 10000}.

try_it_out.definition: Give BADGE a trained multiclass classifier and an unlabeled pool; it returns pool positions to label.

system_provides.name: BADGE batch selector
system_provides.description: BADGE acquisition function returning pool indices.

data_requirements.format: Image tensors shaped (N,C,H,W) or tabular tensors shaped (N,D), with labels for the accumulated labeled set.
data_requirements.auto_download_details: MNIST, CIFAR10, and SVHN can use standard loaders.
data_requirements.synthetic_description: Synthetic multiclass tensors can demonstrate gradient embeddings and diverse selection.

classification.detection_reasoning: The paper is pool-based batch active learning and combines uncertainty and diversity through gradient embeddings and k-MEANS++ rather than Bayesian posterior sampling.

comparison.description: The paper compares BADGE with several acquisition strategies; this v2 artifact documents only BADGE.

pluggable_component.name: select_batch
pluggable_component.description: Compute predicted-label final-layer gradient embeddings and select a diverse batch with randomized k-MEANS++ seeding.

controlled_variables.training_protocol: Retrain from scratch after each acquisition round.

comparison.evaluation_checkpoints: Measure test accuracy as queried labels increase.

model.architecture: Multiclass neural network with a differentiable final layer and penultimate representation.

specific_features.feature: Final output layer with differentiable cross-entropy scores
specific_features.why_essential: BADGE defines embeddings as final-layer cross-entropy gradients.
The gradient embedding uses the penultimate activation.

training.learning_rate: 0.001 for image data and 0.0001 for non-image data

data_setup.special_protocol: Start with M=100 random labels and acquire B=100 labels per round.

blockers.reason: The paper specifies this defining acquisition representation.
blockers.resolution: Compute predicted-label final-layer cross-entropy gradient embeddings.
Apply sequential k-MEANS++ squared nearest-distance sampling.

elements.paper_evidence: Compute gradient embedding using the hypothetical label preferred by the current model and the final-layer cross-entropy gradient.
elements.required_behavior: Predict each candidate label and compute its final-layer gradient under that label.
elements.demo_scale_implementation: Form residual-weighted penultimate-feature blocks on the demo pool.
forbidden_substitutions: Do not replace gradient embeddings with entropy, margin, confidence, raw probabilities, or penultimate embeddings alone.
fairness_checks: Keep model, pool, batch size, and seed fixed.
elements.feasibility_rationale: The formula is explicit and feasible at demo scale.
verification_expectations: Compute predicted-label residuals and final-layer embeddings.

elements.paper_evidence: BADGE samples the batch using k-MEANS++ seeding on gradient embeddings.
elements.required_behavior: Select the first center uniformly and later centers proportional to squared nearest-center distance.
elements.demo_scale_implementation: Apply sequential k-MEANS++ to the gradient embeddings using the supplied seed.
forbidden_substitutions: Do not replace k-MEANS++ with top-K scoring or random selection.
required_controls: Update nearest-center distances after every selection.
fairness_checks: Keep embeddings and candidate pool fixed.
elements.feasibility_rationale: Appendix A specifies a tractable sampler.

methodology_contract_pack.summary: The demo must preserve gradient embeddings and sequential k-MEANS++ batch diversity.
implementation_obligations: Select with sequential k-MEANS++ squared nearest distances.
forbidden_substitutions: Do not replace gradient embeddings with uncertainty-only scores.
Do not replace k-MEANS++ with top-K or random selection.
required_controls: Use fixed model snapshot and candidate pool.
verification_expectations: Check gradient construction and incremental k-MEANS++ distances.
